QuestInfo.name: [NLC] Traveling Checkpoint
QuestInfo.0: Sheriff Lita has one final request for you. Meet up with her and see what it could be.
QuestInfo.1: Sheriff Lita asks you to meet visitors who have entered the city recently and help verify their identities.
QuestInfo.2: Corine, a new visitor to the city, was a member of the ancient Shadowknights and is the last survivor of the Taru clan.

npc.0: To keep order in the city, we have to know who's here and what kind of business they're involved in. I'd like you to investigate a gal named Corine for us.
